_note: Labels for the numbers map (MASTERSPEC 7.3). Shown as the title of each linked number. {design} is the design's name from contracts/copy/labels.json; {year} is a calendar year.

labels.lot_width_actual: This lot's width across the building
labels.building_length_allowed: Building length allowed on this lot
labels.coverage_allowed_pct: Lot coverage allowed on this lot
labels.coverage_actual_pct: Lot coverage of the {design} on this lot
labels.could_lots: House lots where at least one free design may fit (upper bound)
labels.could_pct: Share of house lots where a free design may fit
labels.lots_per_permit: Lots that may fit a design for each multiplex permit issued
labels.borderline_lots: House lots where the closest design is too close to call
labels.nofit_lots: House lots where no free design fits
labels.house_lots: House lots (detached houses, semis and row houses)
labels.attached_pct: Share of house lots that are semis or row houses
labels.flagged_fitting_lots: Lots where a design may fit that need extra review (heritage, ravine or flood area)
labels.units_since_may_2023: Homes created by multiplex permits since May 2023
labels.by_design_fits: House lots where the {design} may fit (upper bound)

top_rule_count.detached_building: House lots that don't fit because the house is attached
top_rule_count.units_allowed: House lots that don't fit because sixplexes are not allowed in this ward
top_rule_count.lot_width: House lots that don't fit because the lot is too narrow for the side yards
top_rule_count.lot_depth: House lots that don't fit because the lot is too shallow for the front and rear yards
top_rule_count.building_length: House lots that don't fit because the lot is not deep enough for the longer building
top_rule_count.height: House lots that don't fit because the height limit is lower than the design
top_rule_count.lot_coverage: House lots that don't fit because the building would cover too much of the lot
